function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values — rows may not be one-per-entity", "implication": "The `patient_id` is not unique per row, and some patients appear more than once. This means that if we compute a mean across all rows, we would be double-counting patients who were re-tested. Since the question asks for the mean across all patients, we must deduplicate the data by keeping only one row per patient. The data dictionary states that the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient. Therefore, we must deduplicate on `patient_id` using the highest `sample_seq`."}
function.name: note_finding
